## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance (deps, config)
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD changes

## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` — zero errors
- [ ] `make typecheck` — zero errors
- [ ] `make security` — no HIGH/CRITICAL findings
- [ ] `make test` — all green, coverage ≥ 80%
- [ ] New or updated tests for all changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed (CLI.md, DEPLOY.md, etc.)
- [ ] No secrets, hardcoded IPs, or absolute paths in code
